source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Ten insertion cases call the new shared checkDateGroup helper, whose Assert.equal compares the actual SQL group with the expected group but has no message argument. The separate SQL-function helper already reports the input and expected group in a nonempty should message. Keep those diagnostics distinct from the actual added coverage: representative groups and grace-period cases are checked, not exact half-hour equality, DST or a fresh intermittent cure.
title: The new grouped-date query helper omits an assertion message
